mapper.select: SELECT PRODUCT_ID AS productId, PRODUCT_NAME AS productName, PRODUCT_POINT AS productPoint, MAIN_IMAGE AS mainImage FROM PRODUCT ORDER BY PRODUCT_POINT DESC
SELECT PRODUCT_ID AS productId, PRODUCT_NAME AS productName, PRODUCT_POINT AS productPoint FROM PRODUCT WHERE PRODUCT_ID = #{productId}

SELECT PRODUCT_ID AS productId, PRODUCT_NAME AS productName, PRODUCT_POINT AS productPoint, MAIN_IMAGE AS mainImage FROM PRODUCT WHERE PRODUCT_NAME LIKE CONCAT('%', #{searchName}, '%') ORDER BY PRODUCT_POINT DESC
SELECT PRODUCT_ID AS productId, PRODUCT_NAME AS productName, PRODUCT_POINT AS productPoint FROM PRODUCT WHERE PRODUCT_ID != #{excludeId} ORDER BY RAND() LIMIT 5
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO PURCHASE_HISTORY (USER_ID, PRODUCT_ID, PURCHASE_DATE) VALUES (#{userId}, #{productId}, NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM PURCHASE_HISTORY WHERE USER_ID = #{userId} AND PRODUCT_ID = #{productId}

SELECT ph.ID AS purchaseId, ph.PRODUCT_ID AS productId, p.PRODUCT_NAME AS productName, p.MAIN_IMAGE AS mainImage, p.PRODUCT_POINT AS productPoint, ph.PURCHASE_DATE AS purchaseDate FROM PURCHASE_HISTORY ph JOIN PRODUCT p ON p.PRODUCT_ID = ph.PRODUCT_ID WHERE ph.USER_ID = #{userId} ORDER BY ph.PURCHASE_DATE DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO POINT_LEDGER (USER_ID, POINT_CHANGE, TRANSACTION_TYPE, DESCRIPTION, CREATED_AT) VALUES (#{userId}, #{point}, #{transactionType}, #{description}, NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT REVIEW_ID AS reviewId, PRODUCT_ID AS productId, USER_ID AS userId, RATING AS rating, CONTENT AS content, CREATED_AT AS createdAt FROM SHOP_REVIEW WHERE PRODUCT_ID = #{productId} ORDER BY CREATED_AT DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO SHOP_REVIEW (PRODUCT_ID, USER_ID, RATING, CONTENT, CREATED_AT) VALUES (#{productId}, #{userId}, #{rating}, #{content}, NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT INQUIRY_ID AS inquiryId, PRODUCT_ID AS productId, USER_ID AS userId, CONTENT AS content, CREATED_AT AS createdAt FROM SHOP_INQUIRY WHERE PRODUCT_ID = #{productId} ORDER BY CREATED_AT DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO SHOP_INQUIRY (PRODUCT_ID, USER_ID, CONTENT, CREATED_AT) VALUES (#{productId}, #{userId}, #{content}, NOW())
